meta.summary: Strict AI spend policy for a scaling software company with envelopes set at 2.0x sector median, enforcing hard agent kill limits and CFO approval on frontier exceptions.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all AI subscriptions must be procured through the approved vendor catalog.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 75% consumed within the calendar month
Team envelope reaches 90% consumed or single-session spend exceeds 3x daily baseline
Team envelope fully consumed or agent kill threshold of $20/hr breached

rationales.e1: Production support-triage inference on Claude Sonnet at $211/day is classified COGS under the production environment rule and falls within the Engineering envelope; no action required.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 are attributed to the Data team, tagged correctly as OpEx, and run well within the $8,000 monthly Data envelope; no action required.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight against unchanged volume, breaching the 20% variance band; Engineering lead is alerted to investigate the deploy for model-tier drift or prompt-length regression.
rationales.e4: Marketing has logged its third ChatGPT Team subscription this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 1 duplicate; the charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI enterprise contract and the employee card transaction is blocked.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $1,000 approval threshold; CFO sign-off is required before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 10-retry-per-task limit, and its $47/hr run rate exceeded the $20/hr kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier exception for the demo build is within the 24-hour approval window and the $100 max delta cap; CFO approval routes the request to the secondary frontier tier for the approved window.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key spiked to 22x baseline with no project tag, triggering ladder step 2 throttle; Engineering lead is notified and the key is rate-limited pending tag attribution, preserving access for attributed experimentation.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent purchased a $499 dataset license, which is within the $500 single-transaction ceiling and falls under the approved data-licensing merchant scope; transaction is logged and cleared.
rationales.e10: Design team's $89/mo AI video trial duplicates a Sales-held tool at $1,400/yr with 40% seat utilization; rerouting Design to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider under a block new-provider rule. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling was misclassified as COGS; the internal-tooling project_tag rule reclassifies the spend to OpEx, correcting the P&L line.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date AI spend has reached 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining, which exceeds the 75% burn alert threshold; Finance lead reviews pacing and applies discretionary throttles to non-critical workloads.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, agent guardrails, and classification rules reconcile with no open exceptions requiring escalation.
